title: Range changes count once each and filled values do not count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges, Default 40% markup, tier A on Same as previous tier.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Change the first range's end to a new value.
  5. Click Add Range.
  6. Click the second range's delete button.
  7. Type 50 in Default's first range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The bar reads "No changes yet".

Step 4:

  • The bar reads 1 change.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 changes (1 + 1).

Step 6:

  • The bar reads 3 changes (2 + 1).

Step 7:

  • The bar reads 4 changes (3 + 1).
  • The gray values filled below and tier A's following cells add nothing to the count.
